title: Natural selection split the brain into two streams

statements.text: Field effects on neurons help some circuits and harm others, so selection raised field sensitivity in some and lowered it in others. The brain evolved a field-sensitive conscious stream of synchronously firing neurons and a field-insensitive nonconscious stream of asynchronously firing neurons.

sources.quote: the theory of natural selection predicts that the brain would evolve into an EM field-insensitive stream associated with asynchronously firing and non-conscious activities, and an EM field-sensitive stream associated with synchronously firing neurons
